purpose: Teach: 変貌/賛美/洞察/バリュー/感度/時速/不必要/インタフェース

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界の変貌に対応しましょう
lines.en: We need to adapt to how the industry is changing.
lines.style: Measured and businesslike opening. Slightly formal register, as though leading a meeting. Clear enunciation on the key point. Expectant pause at the end—waiting for acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。優秀社員を賛美する表彰会を企画します
lines.en: Right. I'll organize an awards ceremony to recognize our top performers.
lines.style: Prompt, attentive response. Respectful but not obsequious. Light emphasis on the concrete action being volunteered. Professional but warm—showing genuine engagement with the idea.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 競合の戦略を洞察しましょう
lines.en: Let's get a clearer read on our competitors' strategy.
lines.style: Steady, forward-leaning tone. Not urgent, but purposeful. The pacing suggests this is a priority worth dwelling on briefly. Eye contact level—expects Kenji to listen carefully.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。バリュー設定を見直します
lines.en: Understood. I'll review our value positioning.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment, then a note of concentration on the task itself. Slightly lower energy than the previous line—he's already moving to the next item mentally. Professional, unrushed.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: SNSの感度を活かしましょう
lines.en: And let's leverage our social media presence more effectively.
lines.style: Light shift in energy—this feels like a newer consideration. Still directive in tone, but with a touch more forward momentum. Slight emphasis on 'leverage' as though inviting creative thinking.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。配送ドライバーの時速管理を徹底します
lines.en: Got it. I'll implement stricter monitoring of our delivery driver schedules.
lines.style: Brisk, efficient acknowledgment. No hesitation—he's latching onto the concrete action immediately. Professional rhythm, slightly clipped at the end to signal readiness for the next point.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 不必要な会議を減らしましょう
lines.en: Let's cut down on unnecessary meetings.
lines.style: Quiet conviction on this one. The tone suggests this comes from some frustration with wasted time, but delivered without complaint. A slight exhale before the final word, as though settling a point that matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内インタフェースを改善します
lines.en: Will do. I'll streamline our internal communications.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly warmer than the previous responses. A sense of closure—he's bringing the list to completion. Steady, reliable tone. The delivery suggests readiness to act and trust in what's been laid out.
